scope: Focused gap review of existing equipment and component identities. Product-index name screening is discovery, not a full audit of every MSE product page. Price and photo adoption requires exact reviewed model/variant or scoped component specification. No new equipment, classes or recipes.

discovery.method: 52 published product sitemaps; normalized make/model substring candidates checked against existing records. Prefix matches and related accessories are not automatic exact matches. Existing MSE-linked XQ records were also checked and already have pictures/prices.
